description: This header file 'libpd.h' defines the WebPA Abstraction APIs, including function declarations for configuring notifications, managing libparodus connections, stopping receive wait threads, and sending notifications. It serves as an interface for the WebPA core functionalities related to Parodus client management.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the initial notification configuration files.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Initializes the libparodus connection and loads the database.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Stops the parodus receive wait thread.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message with specified payload, source, and destination.
